q: 我在厨房，没听___你叫我。
zh: 我在厨房，没听见你叫我。
py: wǒ zài chú fáng méi tīng jiàn nǐ jiào wǒ
en: I was in the kitchen and didn't hear you call me.
why: 听见 means the sound registered, so 没听见 is 'did not hear'. 听懂 would mean not understood the words, and the cue is simply not hearing.

q: 妹妹没找到她的书包___，哭了起来。
zh: 妹妹没找到她的书包，哭了起来。
py: mèi mei méi zhǎo dào tā de shū bāo kū le qǐ lái
en: My sister couldn't find her school bag and started crying.
why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped after 找到. 没找到书包了 is not a normal sentence.

s: 我把那件旧衣服扔着了。
s_py: wǒ bǎ nà jiàn jiù yī fu rēng zháo le
zh: 我把那件旧衣服扔掉了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà jiàn jiù yī fu rēng diào le
en: I threw that old garment away.
why: Getting rid of something takes 掉: 扔掉. 着 (zháo) means the action hit its mark, as in 睡着, and does not combine with 扔.

s: 他太累了，很快就睡觉着了。
s_py: tā tài lèi le hěn kuài jiù shuì jiào zháo le
zh: 他太累了，很快就睡着了。
py: tā tài lèi le hěn kuài jiù shuì zháo le
en: He was so tired that he fell asleep very quickly.
why: The result 着 attaches directly to 睡, and 觉 is dropped: 睡着 is 'fall asleep'. 睡觉着 splits the verb from its result.

src_py: wǒ ná le dì di de shū bāo
task: Say it was a mistake, with 把 and 错.
zh: 我把弟弟的书包拿错了。
py: wǒ bǎ dì di de shū bāo ná cuò le
en: I took my brother's bag by mistake.
why: 错 follows the verb as 拿错. English 'wrongly took' order is not used.

s_py: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì zhōng wén
zh: 请把这句话翻译成中文。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè jù huà fān yì chéng zhōng wén
en: Please translate this sentence into Chinese.
why: 'Into' a language needs 成: 翻译成中文. Without 成 the sentence has no way to say what the sentence turns into.

q: 妈妈把西瓜切___小块，给孩子们吃。
zh: 妈妈把西瓜切成小块，给孩子们吃。
py: mā ma bǎ xī guā qiē chéng xiǎo kuài gěi hái zi men chī
en: Mum cut the watermelon into small pieces for the children.
why: 切成 says what the melon turned into, small pieces. 在 and 到 would need a location, and 给 needs a person.

s_py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán le gěi tā
zh: 我把那本书还给他了。
py: wǒ bǎ nà běn shū huán gěi tā le
en: I gave that book back to him.
why: 了 cannot sit between the verb and 给; 还给 is glued. 了 goes after 他 or at the end.

s: 不做完作业，不能看电视。
s_py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
zh: 不做完作业，不能看电视。
py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
en: No TV unless you finish your homework.
why: This is a condition, not a past event, so 不 before verb + result is correct here. 没 would turn it into a report of what happened.

q: 我在网上学___了做蛋糕。
zh: 我在网上学会了做蛋糕。
py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng xué huì le zuò dàn gāo
en: I learned how to make cakes online.
why: 学会 means learned to and can now do it. 学完 would only say a course ended and 学好 means studied well, so neither says 'learned how to make a cake'.

q: 我昨天去商店，可是___买到那条裙子。
zh: 我昨天去商店，可是没买到那条裙子。
py: wǒ zuó tiān qù shāng diàn kě shì méi mǎi dào nà tiáo qún zi
en: I went to the shop yesterday but didn't get that skirt.
why: A past result that did not happen is negated with 没. 不 is for habits or refusals, and 别 is an imperative.

q: 妈妈做___饭了，快来吃吧。
zh: 妈妈做好饭了，快来吃吧。
py: mā ma zuò hǎo fàn le kuài lái chī ba
en: Mum has dinner ready, come and eat.
why: 好 says the meal is done and ready to eat, which fits 快来吃吧. 会 means learned how to, and 到 / 见 are for reaching or perceiving, so none fits a cooked meal.

zh: 我昨天买到了两张票。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng piào
en: I managed to buy two tickets yesterday.
why: 了 follows the whole result 买到 and precedes the counted object. 买了到 would put 了 between verb and result.

task: Say you have not got it yet.
zh: 我还没买到它。
py: wǒ hái méi mǎi dào tā
en: I haven't got it yet.
why: 还没 before 买到 means not yet, and 了 is dropped.

q: 我昨晚太累，作业没写___，就睡着了。
zh: 我昨晚太累，作业没写完，就睡着了。
py: wǒ zuó wǎn tài lèi zuò yè méi xiě wán jiù shuì zháo le
en: I was so tired last night that I fell asleep without finishing my homework.
why: 没写完 says the homework was left unfinished, which is why falling asleep follows. 会 / 见 do not go with 写, and 没写对 would be about errors.

q: 你在哪里买___这么便宜的菜？
zh: 你在哪里买到这么便宜的菜？
py: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ mǎi dào zhè me pián yi de cài
en: Where did you manage to buy such cheap vegetables?
why: 买到 means succeeded in getting. 买见 does not exist because 见 only follows perception verbs, and 懂 / 会 are not results of buying.

q: 弟弟吃完___三个包子，还想再吃。
zh: 弟弟吃完了三个包子，还想再吃。
py: dì di chī wán le sān gè bāo zi hái xiǎng zài chī
en: My brother finished three buns and still wants more.
why: 了 goes right after the result 完 and before the counted object. 过 would mean ever did, and 着 / 的 cannot follow 吃完.

q: 你想___了没有，到底要买哪个？
zh: 你想好了没有，到底要买哪个？
py: nǐ xiǎng hǎo le méi yǒu dào dǐ yào mǎi nǎ gè
en: Have you made up your mind yet? Which one are you buying?
why: 想好 means has decided, which suits 到底要买哪个. 想完 would just mean finished thinking, and 会 / 见 do not go with 想.

src_py: wǒ chī le fàn rán hòu qù mǎi cài
task: Say 'as soon as I've eaten' with 吃完 and 就.
zh: 我吃完饭就去买菜。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù mǎi cài
en: I'll go and buy groceries as soon as I've eaten.
why: 吃完饭就 is the usual 'after A, then B', with the object after 吃完 and no 了.

task: Make it a polite request with 请 and 把.
zh: 请你把门关好。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ mén guān hǎo
en: Please shut the door properly.
why: 关好 stays together, and 把 puts the door in front of it.

q: 我想把这些美元换___人民币。
zh: 我想把这些美元换成人民币。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè xiē měi yuán huàn chéng rén mín bì
en: I want to exchange these US dollars into renminbi.
why: 换成 states what the money becomes, 人民币. 换给 needs a person, 换在 a place, and 换走 means swapped away.

q: 我在超市看___了姑姑。
zh: 我在超市看见了姑姑。
py: wǒ zài chāo shì kàn jiàn le gū gu
en: I saw my aunt in the supermarket.
why: 'Saw' is a sight that registered, so 看见. 看懂 is understood and 看完 is finished reading; neither can describe seeing a person.

zh: 妈妈把钥匙放在桌子上了。
py: mā ma bǎ yào shi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
en: Mum put the keys on the table.
why: 放在 must be followed at once by the place, so the keys move in front with 把. 放钥匙在桌子上 would split the verb from the thing.

q: 小狗跑到马路上，妈妈大声叫它站___。
zh: 小狗跑到马路上，妈妈大声叫它站住。
py: xiǎo gǒu pǎo dào mǎ lù shàng mā ma dà shēng jiào tā zhàn zhù
en: The puppy ran onto the road and Mum shouted for it to stop.
why: 站住 is the command to stop where you are. 站开 means stand apart and 掉 / 光 do not follow 站.

q: 客人把桌上的蛋糕都带___了。
zh: 客人把桌上的蛋糕都带走了。
py: kè rén bǎ zhuō shàng de dàn gāo dōu dài zǒu le
en: The guests took all the cake on the table away with them.
why: 带走 means carried off with someone, matching guests taking cake home. 带掉 and 带光 are not used, and 着 would be read zhe.

q: 弟弟还没吃___，你别把盘子拿走。
zh: 弟弟还没吃完，你别把盘子拿走。
py: dì di hái méi chī wán nǐ bié bǎ pán zi ná zǒu
en: My brother hasn't finished eating yet, so don't take the plate away.
why: 还没吃完 says eating is unfinished, a good reason not to remove the plate. 吃会 and 吃懂 are not Chinese.

q: 宝宝昨晚哭了很久，十一点才睡___。
zh: 宝宝昨晚哭了很久，十一点才睡着。
py: bǎo bao zuó wǎn kū le hěn jiǔ shí yī diǎn cái shuì zháo
en: The baby cried for a long time last night and only fell asleep at eleven.
why: 睡着 (zháo) is the result 'fell asleep'. 睡完 and 睡见 are not Chinese for this, and 会 never goes after 睡.

q: 姐姐寄的包裹我昨天收___了。
zh: 姐姐寄的包裹我昨天收到了。
py: jiě jie jì de bāo guǒ wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
en: I received the parcel my sister sent yesterday.
why: 收到 means it reached me. 见 works only with perception verbs, and 懂 / 会 are not results of receiving.

q: 我想把这件毛衣送___奶奶。
zh: 我想把这件毛衣送给奶奶。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè jiàn máo yī sòng gěi nǎi nai
en: I want to give this sweater to Grandma.
why: 给 introduces the receiver right after the verb. 在 and 到 would need a place, and 成 would need a new form.

s_py: nǐ de xìn wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
zh: 你的信我昨天收到了。
py: nǐ de xìn wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le
en: I received your letter yesterday.
why: Correct: with the letter as topic, 收到了 closes the sentence. 到 is the result for 'received'; 收见 would be wrong.

src_py: dì di chī guāng le dàn gāo
zh: 弟弟把蛋糕吃光了。
py: dì di bǎ dàn gāo chī guāng le
en: My younger brother ate up the cake.
why: 把 moves the cake in front of 吃光, and 了 stays at the end. 吃光 must stay together.

src_py: hái zi men xǐ gān jìng le shǒu
zh: 孩子们把手洗干净了。
py: hái zi men bǎ shǒu xǐ gān jìng le
en: The children washed their hands clean.
why: 把 puts the hands before the verb, and the pair 洗干净 stays together with 了 after it.

q: 我学___了怎么用洗衣机，现在不用问妈妈了。
zh: 我学会了怎么用洗衣机，现在不用问妈妈了。
py: wǒ xué huì le zěn me yòng xǐ yī jī xiàn zài bù yòng wèn mā ma le
en: I've learned how to use the washing machine, so I don't need to ask Mum now.
why: 学会 is 'learned how to', explaining why asking is no longer needed. 学完 would only say studying ended and 学好 'studied well'.

zh: 我洗完澡就睡觉。
py: wǒ xǐ wán zǎo jiù shuì jiào
en: I'll go to bed as soon as I've had a shower.
why: With the verb-object word 洗澡, the result attaches to the verb part: 洗完澡. 洗澡完 is not said.

s: 弟弟哭了很久，终于睡着了。
s_py: dì di kū le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú shuì zháo le
zh: 弟弟哭了很久，终于睡着了。
py: dì di kū le hěn jiǔ zhōng yú shuì zháo le
en: My brother cried for a long time and finally fell asleep.
why: Correct: 睡着 is the result 'fell asleep'. A bare 睡了 would only say he slept, not that he finally dropped off.

s: 这个月的钱已经花光了，下个月不能再买了。
s_py: zhè gè yuè de qián yǐ jīng huā guāng le xià gè yuè bù néng zài mǎi le
zh: 这个月的钱已经花光了，下个月不能再买了。
py: zhè gè yuè de qián yǐ jīng huā guāng le xià gè yuè bù néng zài mǎi le
en: This month's money is all spent, so no more buying next month.
why: Correct: 花光 means none is left, and 了 follows the pair. The second 了 belongs to the new clause and is independent.

task: Say you did not find it.
zh: 我没找到它。
py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào tā
en: I didn't find it.
why: 没 goes before 找到 and replaces 了; 没找到它了 is not said.

s: 我的零花钱都花光完了。
s_py: wǒ de líng huā qián dōu huā guāng wán le
zh: 我的零花钱都花光了。
py: wǒ de líng huā qián dōu huā guāng le
en: All my pocket money is spent.
why: One verb takes one result: 花光 already means none is left. Adding 完 after 光 stacks two results, which Chinese does not do.

zh: 宝宝昨晚十点就睡着了。
py: bǎo bao zuó wǎn shí diǎn jiù shuì zháo le
en: The baby was already asleep by ten last night.
why: 睡着 is a verb plus result, with 了 after both. 睡了着 would insert 了 between them.

q: 你们吃___饭了吗？
zh: 你们吃完饭了吗？
py: nǐ men chī wán fàn le ma
en: Have you finished eating?
why: 吃完 asks whether eating has reached its end, and the object 饭 follows the pair. 会 and 懂 are about learning or understanding.

q: 他把新买的沙发摆___客厅中间。
zh: 他把新买的沙发摆在客厅中间。
py: tā bǎ xīn mǎi de shā fā bǎi zài kè tīng zhōng jiān
en: He put the new sofa in the middle of the living room.
why: 摆在 takes the place straight after it. 给 needs a person and 成 a new shape, and 摆走 would mean took it away.

s_py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè méi yǒu le
zh: 你做完作业了没有？
py: nǐ zuò wán zuò yè le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished your homework?
why: In this question form 了 comes first and 没有 is the last word. 没有了 would mean 'no longer exist'.

q: 这种牛奶很难买，我跑了三家店才买___。
zh: 这种牛奶很难买，我跑了三家店才买到。
py: zhè zhǒng niú nǎi hěn nán mǎi wǒ pǎo le sān jiā diàn cái mǎi dào
en: This milk is hard to find; I went to three shops before I managed to get it.
why: 才买到 says the purchase succeeded only after three tries. 见 is only for perception verbs, and 懂 / 会 do not suit 买.

zh: 妈妈把三道菜都做好了。
py: mā ma bǎ sān dào cài dōu zuò hǎo le
en: Mum has all three dishes ready.
why: 做好 is a glued pair, and 把 plus 都 bring the dishes in front of it. 做三道菜好了 would break the pair.

q: 说明书写得太难了，爸爸看了三遍还是没看___。
zh: 说明书写得太难了，爸爸看了三遍还是没看懂。
py: shuō míng shū xiě de tài nán le bà ba kàn le sān biàn hái shi méi kàn dǒng
en: The instructions are so hard that Dad read them three times and still didn't understand.
why: 太难 and reading three times point to understanding, so 没看懂. 没看完 would mean he never reached the end, but he read it three times.

q: 哥哥把我的零食都吃___了，一点儿也没留。
zh: 哥哥把我的零食都吃光了，一点儿也没留。
py: gē ge bǎ wǒ de líng shí dōu chī guāng le yī diǎn r yě méi liú
en: My brother ate all my snacks and left none.
why: 一点儿也没留 means nothing is left, so 光. 吃走 is not said and 住 / 开 do not fit eating.

zh: 请把这张一百块换成零钱。
py: qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng yī bǎi kuài huàn chéng líng qián
en: Please change this hundred into small change.
why: 成 needs the new form 零钱 right behind it, so the note moves in front with 把. 换这张一百块成零钱 splits 换成.

q: 我找了半天，终于找___那件外套了。
zh: 我找了半天，终于找到那件外套了。
py: wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān zhōng yú zhǎo dào nà jiàn wài tào le
en: I searched for ages and finally found that coat.
why: 'Found' is 找到: the search reached its target, matching 终于. 找完 would mean finished looking through things, and 懂 / 会 do not go with 找.

zh: 妈妈让我把密码记住。
py: mā ma ràng wǒ bǎ mì mǎ jì zhù
en: Mum told me to memorise the password.
why: 记住 is a glued pair, and 把 puts the password before it. 记密码住 would split the result from the verb.

s_py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù shāng diàn
zh: 我吃完饭就去商店。
py: wǒ chī wán fàn jiù qù shāng diàn
en: I'll go to the shop as soon as I've eaten.
why: Correct: in 'after A, then B' 吃完 normally takes no 了, and 饭 follows the pair. Adding 了 is not needed.

q: 售货员把找的钱递___我，我数了数。
zh: 售货员把找的钱递给我，我数了数。
py: shòu huò yuán bǎ zhǎo de qián dì gěi wǒ wǒ shǔ le shǔ
en: The assistant handed me my change and I counted it.
why: 递给 puts the receiver 我 right after the verb. 在 needs a place, 成 a new form, and 递开 would mean pass apart.

zh: 朋友送给我一件礼物。
py: péng you sòng gěi wǒ yī jiàn lǐ wù
en: A friend gave me a present.
why: 送给 is glued, the receiver 我 comes right after it, and the gift follows. 送我给 reverses them.

zh: 我的零花钱都花光了。
py: wǒ de líng huā qián dōu huā guāng le
en: All my pocket money is spent.
why: With the money as topic, 都 comes before 花光 and 了 ends the sentence. 光花 would put the result before the verb.

q: 客人都到了，可是菜还___做好。
zh: 客人都到了，可是菜还没做好。
py: kè rén dōu dào le kě shì cài hái méi zuò hǎo
en: The guests have all arrived but the dishes aren't ready yet.
why: 还没 plus verb and result says it has not happened yet. 不 would turn it into a refusal or habit, and 别 is a command.

s_py: nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
zh: 你说什么？我没听见。
py: nǐ shuō shén me wǒ méi tīng jiàn
en: What did you say? I didn't hear.
why: Correct: 没听见 is 'did not hear', with 没 before the pair and no 了. Learners wrongly add 了 or use 不.

q: 妈妈买了很多东西，我帮她把门打___。
zh: 妈妈买了很多东西，我帮她把门打开。
py: mā ma mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi wǒ bāng tā bǎ mén dǎ kāi
en: Mum bought a lot of things, so I opened the door for her.
why: 打开 means open, the sensible way to let her in with bags. 打住 means stop and 打走 means drive away.

q: 孩子们把房间打扫___了，妈妈夸了他们。
zh: 孩子们把房间打扫干净了，妈妈夸了他们。
py: hái zi men bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng le mā ma kuā le tā men
en: The children cleaned the room and Mum praised them.
why: Cleaning a room leaves it 干净, which is worth praising. 清楚 is for sight or sound and 对 means correct.

task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 你听懂了吗？
py: nǐ tīng dǒng le ma
en: Did you understand?
why: 了吗 goes after the whole 听懂. 你不听懂吗 would ask about a different thing and does not suit a past event.

src: 我的书包放在椅子上了。
src_py: wǒ de shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng le
task: Say who did it: begin with 我 and use 把.
zh: 我把书包放在椅子上了。
py: wǒ bǎ shū bāo fàng zài yǐ zi shàng le
en: I put my bag on the chair.
why: With the doer as subject, the bag goes in front with 把 and 放在 keeps the place right behind it.

s_py: wǒ kàn shū wán le
zh: 我看完书了。
py: wǒ kàn wán shū le
en: I've finished reading.
why: 看完 is one unit, so 书 comes after it. Putting 书 between 看 and 完 splits the result from its verb.

q: 出门以前，我们要先把东西准备___。
zh: 出门以前，我们要先把东西准备好。
py: chū mén yǐ qián wǒ men yào xiān bǎ dōng xi zhǔn bèi hǎo
en: Before going out, we need to get everything ready first.
why: 准备好 means ready. 会 and 见 do not suit 准备, and 走 would mean prepared away.

zh: 我没找到那件毛衣。
py: wǒ méi zhǎo dào nà jiàn máo yī
en: I didn't find that sweater.
why: 没 goes before the whole 找到 and there is no 了. 找没到 splits the verb and its result.

q: 价格牌上的字太小，我没看___价钱。
zh: 价格牌上的字太小，我没看清楚价钱。
py: jià gé pái shàng de zì tài xiǎo wǒ méi kàn qīng chu jià qián
en: The writing on the price tag was too small and I couldn't see the price clearly.
why: 字太小 means the sight was not clear, so 没看清楚. 干净 is for cleaning, and 看走 / 看掉 do not exist.

q: 昨天太吵了，我一晚上都没睡___。
zh: 昨天太吵了，我一晚上都没睡着。
py: zuó tiān tài chǎo le wǒ yī wǎn shang dōu méi shuì zháo
en: It was so noisy yesterday that I couldn't fall asleep all night.
why: 没睡着 means never managed to fall asleep. 睡到 needs a time or place, and 会 never follows 睡.

src_py: wǒ sòng tā yī fèn shēng rì lǐ wù
task: Rewrite with 把 and 送给.
zh: 我把生日礼物送给他了。
py: wǒ bǎ shēng rì lǐ wù sòng gěi tā le
en: I gave him the birthday present.
why: With 把 the gift goes in front, so 送给 takes the receiver 他 straight after it.

q: 他把一百块换___了零钱。
zh: 他把一百块换成了零钱。
py: tā bǎ yī bǎi kuài huàn chéng le líng qián
en: He changed the hundred yuan into small change.
why: 成 marks what the money turned into, here 零钱. 给 and 在 need a person or a place, and 换到 would not give 'into'.

s: 你有没有找到你昨天放在客厅里的书包？
s_py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhǎo dào nǐ zuó tiān fàng zài kè tīng lǐ de shū bāo
zh: 你有没有找到你昨天放在客厅里的书包？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu zhǎo dào nǐ zuó tiān fàng zài kè tīng lǐ de shū bāo
en: Did you find the bag you left in the living room yesterday?
why: Correct: 有没有 + verb + result is a common alternative to 了没有. The result 找到 stays glued with the object after it.

q: 收银员把钱数___了，一共是五十块，没有问题。
zh: 收银员把钱数对了，一共是五十块，没有问题。
py: shōu yín yuán bǎ qián shǔ duì le yī gòng shì wǔ shí kuài méi yǒu wèn tí
en: The cashier counted the money correctly: fifty yuan in all, no problem.
why: 没有问题 shows the count came out right, so 数对. 数错 would mean a mistake, and 光 / 走 are about money disappearing.

q: 妈妈把钥匙放___门口的桌子上了。
zh: 妈妈把钥匙放在门口的桌子上了。
py: mā ma bǎ yào shi fàng zài mén kǒu de zhuō zi shàng le
en: Mum put the keys on the table by the door.
why: 放在 is followed at once by the place where the keys end up. 给 needs a person and 成 needs a new form.

q: 商店里太吵了，我没听___店员说的价格。
zh: 商店里太吵了，我没听清楚店员说的价格。
py: shāng diàn lǐ tài chǎo le wǒ méi tīng qīng chu diàn yuán shuō de jià gé
en: The shop was so noisy that I didn't hear the price the assistant said clearly.
why: Noise is a hearing problem, so 听清楚. 听懂 would claim the words were not understood, and 干净 means clean.

s: 我们把旧沙发搬走了，换了一个新的。
s_py: wǒ men bǎ jiù shā fā bān zǒu le huàn le yī gè xīn de
zh: 我们把旧沙发搬走了，换了一个新的。
py: wǒ men bǎ jiù shā fā bān zǒu le huàn le yī gè xīn de
en: We carried the old sofa away and got a new one.
why: Correct: 搬走 means moved away from here, and 把 puts the sofa before it. 走 is the right result for taking something off.

s_py: mā ma xǐ hěn gān jìng le yī fu
zh: 妈妈洗干净了衣服。
py: mā ma xǐ gān jìng le yī fu
en: Mum washed the clothes clean.
why: The result 干净 attaches straight to 洗; 很 cannot be inserted. 洗得很干净 would be a different pattern with 得.

s: 你说得太快，我没听清楚了。
s_py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng qīng chu le
zh: 你说得太快，我没听清楚。
py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
en: You spoke too fast and I didn't hear clearly.
why: 没 already says the result did not happen, so 了 is dropped. 没听清楚了 is not a normal sentence.

src: 孩子们把房间打扫干净了。
src_py: hái zi men bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng le
zh: 孩子们没把房间打扫干净。
py: hái zi men méi bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo gān jìng
en: The children didn't get the room cleaned.
why: 没 goes before 把, and 了 is dropped. 把房间没打扫干净了 puts the negative in the wrong spot.

q: 你的新手机买___了没有？
zh: 你的新手机买到了没有？
py: nǐ de xīn shǒu jī mǎi dào le méi yǒu
en: Have you got your new phone yet?
why: The question asks whether the purchase succeeded, so 买到 plus 了没有. 买走, 买见 and 买懂 do not express getting something.

q: 妈妈用力把窗户推___，屋里一下子亮了。
zh: 妈妈用力把窗户推开，屋里一下子亮了。
py: mā ma yòng lì bǎ chuāng hu tuī kāi wū lǐ yī xià zi liàng le
en: Mum pushed the window open hard and the room suddenly brightened.
why: 推开 means push something open or apart, and the room getting light confirms it. 推住 means hold it still and 推走 means push it away.

task: Ask whether it has happened, with 没有.
zh: 奶奶睡着了没有？
py: nǎi nai shuì zháo le méi yǒu
en: Has Grandma fallen asleep yet?
why: The question form is verb + result + 了没有, with 没有 last. 睡没有着 would split the pair.

s_py: diàn yuán zhǎo hěn cuò qián le
zh: 店员找错钱了。
py: diàn yuán zhǎo cuò qián le
en: The shop assistant gave the wrong change.
why: 错 is a result glued straight to the verb: 找错. 很 cannot be wedged in between, so 找很错 is not Chinese; the right form is 找错钱了.

zh: 你吃完了没有？
py: nǐ chī wán le méi yǒu
en: Have you finished eating?
why: The question ends in 了没有, with 了 after the whole 吃完 and 没有 as the last word. 吃了完 splits the result.

zh: 奶奶没听见。
py: nǎi nai méi tīng jiàn
en: Grandma didn't hear.
why: 没 before 听见 negates the result, and 了 disappears. 奶奶听见没了 is not Chinese.

s_py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ bù tīng dǒng
zh: 昨天的课我没听懂。
py: zuó tiān de kè wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand yesterday's class.
why: A result that failed on a past occasion is negated with 没. 昨天 puts this firmly in the past, so 不 cannot be used.

q: 这封信太长，我只看了一半，还没看___。
zh: 这封信太长，我只看了一半，还没看完。
py: zhè fēng xìn tài cháng wǒ zhǐ kàn le yī bàn hái méi kàn wán
en: This letter is so long that I've only read half and haven't finished it.
why: 只看了一半 means the end has not been reached, so 没看完. 没看懂 would be about understanding and 没看见 about not seeing it.

q: 弟弟猜___了盒子里是什么，高兴得跳起来。
zh: 弟弟猜对了盒子里是什么，高兴得跳起来。
py: dì di cāi duì le hé zi lǐ shì shén me gāo xìng de tiào qǐ lái
en: My brother guessed right what was in the box and jumped for joy.
why: Jumping for joy fits a right guess, so 猜对. 猜错 would give no reason to be happy.

zh: 请你把这些旧衣服送给表妹。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè xiē jiù yī fu sòng gěi biǎo mèi
en: Please give these old clothes to my cousin.
why: 送给 takes the receiver right after it, and 把 puts the clothes in front of the verb. 送给 cannot be cut apart.

zh: 爸爸把价钱看错了。
py: bà ba bǎ jià qián kàn cuò le
en: Dad misread the price.
why: 错 comes right after the verb as 看错, and 了 follows the pair. 错看 copies English 'wrongly read' order and is not Chinese.

q: 爸爸把旧电视卖___了，换了一台新的。
zh: 爸爸把旧电视卖掉了，换了一台新的。
py: bà ba bǎ jiù diàn shì mài diào le huàn le yī tái xīn de
en: Dad sold off the old TV and got a new one.
why: 掉 means the old TV is gone for good. 光 would say every one was sold or nothing is left, which does not fit a single TV, and 开 / 住 do not describe selling.

q: 我去晚了，没买___那双鞋。
zh: 我去晚了，没买到那双鞋。
py: wǒ qù wǎn le méi mǎi dào nà shuāng xié
en: I got there too late and didn't get those shoes.
why: 买 only attempts a purchase; 买到 means it succeeded. 见 works only with perception verbs like 看 and 听, and 会 / 懂 are about learning or understanding.

q: 我买到___两张电影票，一起去吧。
zh: 我买到了两张电影票，一起去吧。
py: wǒ mǎi dào le liǎng zhāng diàn yǐng piào yī qǐ qù ba
en: I got two film tickets, let's go together.
why: 了 follows the result 到 and comes before the counted object. 买到过 would mean once got, which does not suggest going together now.

zh: 弟弟没看见我。
py: dì di méi kàn jiàn wǒ
en: My brother didn't see me.
why: 没 goes before the whole 看见, with no 了. 看没见 and 没见看 break the glued pair.

q: 我把价钱算___了，多给了他十块。
zh: 我把价钱算错了，多给了他十块。
py: wǒ bǎ jià qián suàn cuò le duō gěi le tā shí kuài
en: I worked out the price wrongly and gave him ten yuan too much.
why: 多给了十块 shows the sum went wrong, so 算错. 算对 would mean no overpayment, and 算完 says nothing about being wrong.

src_py: tā rēng diào le jiù xié
zh: 他把旧鞋扔掉了。
py: tā bǎ jiù xié rēng diào le
en: He threw away the old shoes.
why: 把 moves the shoes in front of 扔掉, and 了 goes at the end.

q: 我把新买的鞋放___鞋柜里了。
zh: 我把新买的鞋放在鞋柜里了。
py: wǒ bǎ xīn mǎi de xié fàng zài xié guì lǐ le
en: I put the new shoes in the shoe cabinet.
why: 放在 plus a place says where the shoes ended up. 给 and 成 need a person or a new form, and 放走 would mean let go.

q: 这个月的零花钱我都花___了，只好向妈妈借。
zh: 这个月的零花钱我都花光了，只好向妈妈借。
py: zhè gè yuè de líng huā qián wǒ dōu huā guāng le zhǐ hǎo xiàng mā ma jiè
en: I've spent all my pocket money this month, so I have to borrow from Mum.
why: 光 means none is left, which is why borrowing is the only option. 花住 and 花开 describe nothing here, and 会 is for learned skills.

task: Say it has not happened yet.
zh: 我还没吃完。
py: wǒ hái méi chī wán
en: I haven't finished eating yet.
why: 还没 plus verb and result means not yet, and 了 is dropped. 还没吃完了 is wrong.

q: 请把妈妈的电话号码记___，别忘了。
zh: 请把妈妈的电话号码记住，别忘了。
py: qǐng bǎ mā ma de diàn huà hào mǎ jì zhù bié wàng le
en: Please remember Mum's phone number and don't forget it.
why: 记住 means fix it in memory, matching 别忘了. 记掉 would mean get rid of, and 开 / 走 do not combine with 记.

q: 妈妈把碗洗___了，可以用了。
zh: 妈妈把碗洗干净了，可以用了。
py: mā ma bǎ wǎn xǐ gān jìng le kě yǐ yòng le
en: Mum washed the bowls clean, so they can be used.
why: Washing leaves things 干净 (clean), which is why they can be used. 清楚 is for sight or sound and 对 means right or correct.

s_py: wǒ xiě le wán zuò yè
zh: 我写完作业了。
py: wǒ xiě wán zuò yè le
en: I've finished my homework.
why: 了 never sits between the verb and its result. It goes after 完 or at the end of the sentence.

zh: 我们吃完饭就去商店。
py: wǒ men chī wán fàn jiù qù shāng diàn
en: We'll go to the shop as soon as we've eaten.
why: 吃完 is one unit with the object 饭 after it, and an 'after A, then B' sentence takes no 了. 吃饭完 splits the unit.

q: 奶奶把钱包交___了妈妈。
zh: 奶奶把钱包交给了妈妈。
py: nǎi nai bǎ qián bāo jiāo gěi le mā ma
en: Grandma handed the purse to Mum.
why: 交给 is 'hand over to', with the receiver 妈妈 right after. 成 and 在 do not take a person, and 走 would mean taken away.

q: 这件衣服太旧了，妈妈让我把它扔___。
zh: 这件衣服太旧了，妈妈让我把它扔掉。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu tài jiù le mā ma ràng wǒ bǎ tā rēng diào
en: This piece of clothing is too old, so Mum told me to throw it away.
why: 扔掉 means get rid of. 扔走 is not said, and 扔着 and 扔会 are not words.
